meta.title: Al Shafaq Al Qutbi Logistics Services
meta.description: Trusted logistics and freight services across Jordan, the Levant, the Gulf, and global trade lanes.

hero.kicker: Al Shafaq Al Qutbi Logistics Services
hero.heading: Your trusted logistics partner from Jordan to the world.
hero.description: Built for a professional regional operator: clear hierarchy, blue-dominant surfaces, orange as an accent, and typography that stays sharp across desktop and mobile.

capabilities.title: Design system foundation
capabilities.copy: The repo now uses one shared visual language for colors, spacing, shadows, and typography so new pages can be assembled without drifting away from the brand.
capabilities.speed: Fast, clear layouts that stay easy to scan on every screen.
capabilities.contrast: Strong contrast on every surface and component.
capabilities.tokens: Reusable tokens for spacing, radius, shadows, and color.
capabilities.typography: Montserrat-first typography with Arabic fallback support.

services.title: Core services
services.copy: The homepage now reads like a real logistics brand landing page while staying grounded in the same token set for future expansion.

freightForwarding.title: Freight Forwarding
freightForwarding.description: Air, sea, and land coordination with clear milestones, shipment visibility, and dependable handoffs.

crossBorderLogistics.title: Cross-Border Logistics
crossBorderLogistics.description: Regional movement planning across Jordan, the Levant, and Gulf trade routes with practical execution.

customsSupport.title: Customs Support
customsSupport.description: Documentation and clearance coordination that keeps shipments moving with fewer surprises.

implementation.heading: A practical setup for real pages.
implementation.copy: Use the same semantic tokens for every future section so cards, buttons, and headings stay visually consistent without rewriting local styles.

whatWeCover.title: What the system already covers
whatWeCover.one: Semantic color tokens for surfaces, text, borders, and brand accents.
whatWeCover.two: Shared spacing scale and container width for consistent page rhythm.
whatWeCover.three: Next.js font loading through next/font with Montserrat and Cairo.
